title: Kamailio Presentations at Fosdem 2011
html:
Fosdem 2011 edition was again very successful. The only problem that comes (naturally) to this event: it started to be very crowded, making a challenge to attend any kind of speech there.

We were several developers and community members of Kamailio project and many others from the VoIP world, Saturday evening we had the traditional Kamailio dinner, this time in a fancy restaurant, but with very tasteful menu choices.

In the Open Source Telephony Devroom, Kamailio had two presentations:

  • Henning Westerholt and Marius Zbihlei, 1&1 Germany – Scaling Location Services in Large SIP Networks with Kamailio – slides available here
  • Daniel-Constantin Mierla, Asipto Germany – Unifying SIP and Web Worlds with Lua – slides available here

We look forward to the next year edition!
